entries.title: Northgard
entries.definitive_edition: Northgard: The Viking Age Edition bundle on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with current updates and owned DLC. No emulation is needed for the primary route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with current Steam build, Workshop/map-editor support, and full owned DLC set.

primary.version: Northgard: The Viking Age Edition bundle on PC
primary.why: Northgard is available across PC, console, and mobile, but the PC release has the strongest capture/settings route and the broadest current content set. Steam now presents the base game as Northgard: Definitive Edition, lists Windows, macOS, and Linux support, and offers the Viking Age Edition bundle with the remaining clan DLCs and soundtrack; console and mobile storefronts list smaller DLC sets. Use Windows PC for the archive route and install the current Definitive Edition plus the remaining gameplay DLC before capture.
primary.how_to_play: Play Northgard: Definitive Edition on Windows PC through Steam, then add the remaining clan DLCs through the Viking Age Edition bundle or equivalent owned DLC list. Use console or mobile only for convenience/comparison captures, not as the definitive archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the highest settings/capture ceiling, Workshop/map-editor support, major free updates, Cross of Vidar story content, and the broadest current clan DLC route.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most complete current gameplay route when the Definitive Edition and remaining DLC are installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Console port with TV/handheld play and Nintendo Switch Online support.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful portable console route, but lower fidelity and less complete than the current PC DLC path.

all_releases.fidelity: Console port with online play and a smaller listed add-on set.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive content over PC; the PC version has higher fidelity and broader DLC coverage.

all_releases.platform: Xbox One / Xbox Series X|S compatibility
all_releases.fidelity: Xbox console route with online co-op, online multiplayer, and listed clan add-ons.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive content over PC; Xbox Series compatibility is convenient but not the complete PC DLC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile port redesigned for touch with iCloud progress sharing and mobile in-app clan DLC.
all_releases.reason: skip: good portable route but a separate mobile port with a smaller DLC set than PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile port redesigned for touch with Android cloud save and mobile in-app clan DLC.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful mobile route, but not the highest-fidelity or most complete current content route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Mobile and Switch are convenient portable options, but the PC route has both the fidelity ceiling and the broadest current DLC/update coverage.

entries.remaster_caveats: Northgard: Definitive Edition is the current base-game label, but the most complete archive route should verify all remaining clan DLC ownership as well; do not assume console or mobile DLC catalogs match the PC catalog.
